assumptions: The GlobalWave contract ends on 2029-03-01 with no automatic renewal. The contract still needs to be checked for a non-renewal notice deadline, auto-renew terms, data-return and exit-assistance terms.
A replacement must be live, staff trained, and GlobalWave data archived or converted before 2029-03-01.
The working target is go-live by 2028-08-01, which leaves about 7 months of buffer.
Bank profile figures come from the Head of Commercial Lending and are treated as accurate. Vendor, pricing and regulatory points are working views until confirmed (see What we think).
